parameters.query: UPDATE leads.candidates SET email = COALESCE(NULLIF($2, ''), email), linkedin_url = COALESCE(NULLIF($4, ''), linkedin_url), enrichment = enrichment || $3::jsonb, enriched_at = now(), stage = CASE WHEN stage = 'discovered' THEN 'enriched' ELSE stage END, stage_updated_at = CASE WHEN stage = 'discovered' THEN now() ELSE stage_updated_at END WHERE id = $1::bigint

parameters.content:
## Lead Intelligence Engine v1

Every 30 min: takes up to 60 candidates in stage=discovered with a website, fetches the homepage, extracts contact emails (regex + preference ranking), writes email + enrichment jsonb back, advances stage to enriched.

Failed fetches still advance stage (with enrichment.error set) so the queue drains. Candidates without websites are marked enriched separately (phone-only leads).
